6.description: [Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [Gruul the Dragonkiller] Corrected an issue where Reverberation had a corrupted spell visual.

[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar] Corrected an issue where High King Maulgar would skip or delay events while whirlwinding.

In this case the previous Champion claims his titel for another 25% of his maximum health and keeps all previously gathered stacks of Maulgar's Champion.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar] High King Maulgar will now announce his chosen  Champion.

7.description: [Pending Patch] [Stormgarde] Stormgarde now once again has a thunder style visual that wont flashbang your fellow heroes!

[Pending Restart/Patch] [One With The Light] One With The Light now only grants 1 additional stack of Holy Specialization instead of 2. (This has been reduced because the stack count of Holy Specialization has been reduced from 10 max down to 5 max.)
[Pending Restart/Patch] [One With The Light] Empowered Light reduces the cast time of your next Holy Fire by 25% per stack. Stacking 4 times.

[Pending Restart/Patch] [One With The Light] One With The Lights Holy Fire cast time reduction has been moved to its own buff instead of being tied to Holy Specialization. This new buff is called Empowered Light. (This means it won’t be consumed by casting other holy spells in your rotation and is independant from Holy Specialization, this should smooth out the rotation and add quality of life to the feel of it.)
[Pending restart][Lucifur] Fixed an issue where Cataclysm did not have a global cooldown.
[Pending restart][Lucifur] Adjusted the base damage and level scaling of Cataclysm. This functionally means nothing for max level.
[Pending restart][Lucifur] Devil's Ignition SP and AP scaling has been increased by 20%.
[Pending restart][Lucifur] Reduced Charred Bite direct damage, reduced base damage overall and increased the scaling so SP and AP the increases will now be noticeable.
[Pending restart][Lucifur] Adjusted base damage and scaling per combo point for the dot from Charred Bite. The base will be around 30-40% lower on all ranks and scaling has been reduced by 30%.
[Pending restart][Blood for the Blood God] Reduced the duration of Bathe in Blood to 9 seconds. Down from 12 seconds.
[Pending restart][Edge of Fury] Edge of Fury now increases damage of your next Killing Spree by 15%. Down from 20%.
[Pending restart][Edge of Fury] Decreased base damage and scaling of Blind Revenge and Spiteful Strike by 10%.
[Pending restart][Dark Ranger] Increased the scaling of Shadow Arrow damage over time by 20%.
[Pending restart][Dark Ranger] Increased the weapon damage contribution of Shadow Arrow to 120%. Up form 90%.
[Pending restart][Dark Ranger] Increased the scaling of Blood Arrow damage over time by 20%.
[Pending restart][Dark Ranger] Increased the weapon damage contribution of Blood Arrow to 90%. Up from 70%.
[Pending restart][Master of Shadows] Casting Shadow bolt through Nightfall will trigger two instances of shadow damage, both will critically hit.

[Pending restart][Master of Shadows] increased damage and scaling of the shadow damage proc by 30%. It is now able to critically strike by default (does not require the original ability to crit). However, scoring a critical hit with rogue ability WILL still guarantee the triggered damage to critically hit.

[Pending restart][Master of Shadows] Gloomblade Criticals will trigger Apprentice of Shadows. Additionally, initial hit of Glooblade now also triggers additional shadow damage, same as other abilities within Master of Shadows toolkit.

[Pending restart][Shadow Arrow] Shadow Arrow has been renamed to Shadow Arsenal, now it also triggers of Gloomblade. Now it reads: Your Black Arrow and Gloomblade abilities now increase the shadow damage done by your spells and abilities. Black Arrow by 10%.  Gloomblade by 5%. These effects do not stack.
[Pending restart][Fire Watch] Increased the duration of Exploding Storm buff to 20 seconds.
[Pending restart][Primordial Fury] Increased the weapon damage contribution to the Primordial fury damage proc to 85%. Up from 70%.
[Pending restart][Static shock] Rare Mystic Enchant now also increases the damage of your Lightning Shield by 10%.
[Pending restart][Righteous Flames] Inner Flames is now a single target spell. Its damage has been greatly increased to account for this.
[Pending restart][Righteous Flames] Increased the amount of Inner Fire charges generated via Holy Fire (Righteous Flames) damaging hits to 10.
[Pending restart][Elemental Lord] No longer prohibits buffs granted by Elemenal Blast.
[Pending restart][Elemental Lord] Elemental Earth/Frost/Fire now increase damage of your next shock by 150% (75% against players). Up from 100%.
[Pending restart][Elemental Lord] Elemental Air now also increases the damage dealt to monsters by your next Elemental Blast by 30%.
[Pending restart][Stormborn] Fixed an issue where Stormborn damage proc had lower hybrid scaling than intended.
[Pending restart][Forbidden Technique] Shadow Powers now decreases the cooldown of your Forbidden Technique by 3 seconds.
